name: OpenRouter
description: Model provider for OpenRouter (and other OpenAI-compatible APIs) with tool calling, fallbacks and a model allow/block policy.

permissions.reason: Send your prompts to the OpenRouter API. Add hosts if you point baseUrl at another OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Authenticate to OpenRouter with your API key (get one at https://openrouter.ai/keys).

providers.title: OpenRouter
providers.description: Hundreds of models behind one API. Default: Claude Opus 5.5 with Sonnet 5.5 fallback.

commands.name: models
commands.title: List allowed models with tool support

commands.name: check
commands.title: Explain whether a model is allowed by the policy

fallbackModels.description: Tried in order if the primary model is unavailable (OpenRouter `models` routing).

fastModel.description: Cheap model used when plugins call the model (llm.invoke).

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort for models that support it.

blockedModels.description: Policy rules. 'vendor/family>=N' blocks major version N and newer; globs block by pattern. Aliases (~) and routers are blocked because they can resolve to a blocked model.
